svg.title: How a booking flows through Bindu Clinic
svg.desc: Five steps: find or ask, check availability, choose a time, confirm and book, then after booking.
svg.text: Bindu Clinic: how a booking flows
From "I need a doctor" to a confirmed appointment, on the website or through Mitra, the chat assistant
Pick a doctor by specialty, then a date, then a time.
“I need a pediatrician” · “Book Dr. Anil tomorrow”
Works in a small chat window on every page.
Availability engine · one tested function used by both the screens and the booking itself
Doctor's working days and breaks · leave · existing bookings · 1 hour minimum notice · 30-day booking window.
A date with no times is never a dead end: it explains why, offers the nearest valid dates and colleagues in the same specialty.
The website and Mitra ask the same engine, so they can never disagree about what is free.
Date strip shows the next bookable days.
Time buttons show only slots that are really free.
Days the doctor does not work are not offered.
Choosing a time opens the details form.
Everything is checked again on the server at booking.
Dates and times are formatted by the server. No names, phones or emails
reach the model. It shows tappable time buttons, and it can only propose a booking.
Only if you answered Yes: a confirmation now
and a reminder 24 hours before. Queued in the
same transaction as the booking, so nothing is
sent for a booking that did not save.
My appointments: verify your mobile with a
WhatsApp code, then view, cancel or
reschedule. A rescheduled booking gets a new
Admin and doctor roles: appointments, leave
and an audit log. Short-lived tokens, and every
change is recorded without phone numbers.
Every integration (AI, retrieval, WhatsApp) has a mock mode, so the app also runs offline.
